notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strongest hits are clause-opening prepositions/conjunctions (after, before, over, when, for, with, 'in' in 'for x in') and 'you' in a conditional, i.e. a setup adjunct awaiting its main clause; the pole is sparse (0.3% of tokens above 0.1 max), mixed across prose and code, and no single token covers it, so this is a loose syntactic-role label that may only partly hold.
